PAGE-009.summary: Time display: while script runs, the page's generation time shows a relative label, with the absolute time in the configured timezone and its UTC offset in its tooltip and the ISO 8601 instant in its datetime; the initial HTML, script-disabled readers and incident, maintenance, feed and notification timestamps keep the absolute display (owner S4, 20 October 2026).
PAGE-009.was: Time display: Every timestamp on a public surface or in a notification is rendered in the page's configured timezone with its UTC offset, and every timestamp on the page carries the same instant as an ISO 8601 value in a machine-readable attribute.
PAGE-009.now: Time display: Every timestamp on a public surface or in a notification is rendered in the page's configured timezone with its UTC offset, and every timestamp on the page carries the same instant as an ISO 8601 value in a machine-readable attribute. Owner exception (S4, DIVERGENCE.md "Public page clarity — owner L10, 20 October 2026"): while script runs, the page's generation time shows a relative label, refreshed while the page is open. Its tooltip gives the absolute time in the configured timezone with its UTC offset, and its `datetime` keeps the ISO 8601 instant. The initial HTML and script-disabled readers see the absolute time. UPTIME-003.summary: Short history: the figure is labeled with its coverage, elapsed hours and minutes while it covers less than one whole day ("less than 1 minute" below a minute) and whole days from one day onward, and a component with no data says No data (owner S4, 20 October 2026).

UPTIME-003.now: Short history: A component whose earliest state history entry is later than the start of the reporting window shows uptime computed from that entry, and the page labels the figure with the coverage: elapsed hours and minutes while it covers less than one whole day ("less than 1 minute" below a minute), and whole days from one day onward. A component with no data says No data (owner S4, DIVERGENCE.md "Public page clarity").

migrations.buyerSteps: Apply after 0042. Adds the saved built-in page template (default preserves the existing page) and an optional region on components. Additive; no existing data changes or configuration inputs.
Apply after 0043. Adds the page's House style choice, off for every existing page, so every page keeps the template it saved. Additive; no existing data changes or configuration inputs.

agentUpdateInstructions: Two additive migrations since 1.10.0 apply on deploy: 0043_page_templates.sql adds a saved page template, set to default (the existing page) for every existing page, and an optional component region; 0044_house_style_template.sql adds the House style choice, off for every existing page. No extension-point change, and stored data stays compatible. House style is made with an install's Workers AI binding, which Base does not yet grant an app Worker: until it does, a page that chooses House style shows Calm headline and says it is not connected, and Setup on a fresh install saves Calm headline. Back up data and owner source first, update the checkout, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (the checkout pins rer 0.2.76 with no rer patch) and rer deploy as before. PAGE-009 and UPTIME-003 now state the relative generation label and first-day coverage labels that the 1.10.0 public page already shows. Run rer verify and pnpm run validate:release before adopting.
